theme: Menu, cost of goods, suppliers, waste

extra.howNumbersWereChecked: Session of November 14, 2026. Direct page fetches were blocked by the session's network policy (the proxy answered 403), so every number was read through web search. verified = the search was restricted to the primary source's own domain (fred.stlouisfed.org, bls.gov, tax.ny.gov, nyc.gov, dec.ny.gov, webstaurantstore.com and so on) and returned the number from that page. estimate = seen only in a secondary source, or my own arithmetic; the note gives the calculation. Recipes (grams of coffee, ounces of milk) are industry practice, not statistics: they are marked estimate and the note says where the practice is described. Effects of events and levers on demand, quality and reputation are design values for the lead to balance.

history.what: the record that stood for 47 years
record after the Brazil drought; broken again in October 2025
lowest since late September on a record Brazil crop forecast (71.9 million bags for 2026/27)

signals.passThrough: A roaster buys green coffee months ahead, so the wholesale price list follows the exchange with a lag of one to two quarters and falls more slowly than it rises. A roaster's rule of thumb: $1 per lb on the wholesale price is about 5 cents per cup or double shot.
signals.note: Read through search summaries of Trading Economics (Nov 6, 2026: about $2.80 per lb; Nov 2: above $2.90), Barchart ($4.2995 in February 2025; $3.4835 on December 10, 2024) and Bloomberg (October 2025: the February record was surpassed). I could not open the exchange's own page.

signals.name: BLS average price, 100% ground roast coffee, per lb, US city average (APU0000717311)
signals.note: FRED page updated November 10, 2026: September 2026 $9.332, October 2026 $9.249, September 2025 $9.139. Supermarket shelf price, not a cafe's wholesale price: it shows direction, not level. Retail stayed high in 2026 while futures fell by about a third.

signals.name: USDA advanced base Class I (fluid milk) price, per cwt, announced around the 20th for the next month

history.what: up $1.39 in one month; $3.52 above November 2025

signals.passThrough: One cwt is about 11.6 gallons, so $1.39 per cwt is about 12 cents a gallon at the farm-to-plant level. New Jersey's milk regulator publishes the same price with a monthly fuel adjuster ($1.49 per cwt for November 2026). Dairies re-price their list monthly from this announcement, so a cafe sees the change in the next invoice.
signals.note: Read through search: USDA Dairy Market News for the week of October 19, 2026 cites the Announcement of Advanced Prices released October 21, 2026: base Class I for November 2026 is $20.27 per cwt, up $1.39 from October. 100 lb / 8.6 lb per gallon = 11.6 gallons. The Northeast order adds a location differential on top of the base.

signals.name: BLS average price, whole milk, per gallon, US city average (APU0000709112)
signals.note: FRED page updated November 10, 2026. Range inside 2026: $4.026 to $4.317, a swing of 7%.

signals.name: BLS average price, Grade A large eggs, per dozen, US city average (APU0000708111)
signals.note: FRED page updated November 10, 2026. From record to October 2026 the price fell 63%: an egg sandwich that cost 52 cents of egg in March 2025 costs 19 cents now (one egg = 1/12 dozen).

signals.name: Kyoto spring tencha auction (the leaf matcha is ground from), yen per kg, machine-picked average

history.what: implied: the 2025 price was a 170% rise

signals.passThrough: US wholesalers re-priced in June 2025 and March 2026 and set purchase limits; cafe owners reported waits growing from one or two months to six.
signals.note: Read through search: Global Japanese Tea Association report for May 2026 (secondary; I did not find the market's own release). 8,235 / 2.7 = about 4,862 yen for 2024 is my arithmetic from 'a 170% increase'.

ingredients.name: Espresso blend, wholesale, 5 lb bags
ingredients.note: Joe Coffee (New York) lists its Waverly espresso blend to wholesale buyers on Faire at $80 for 5 lb = $16.00 per lb (search summary of the Faire listing; I could not open the roaster's own wholesale price list, which sits behind a login). Cross-checks: Atomic house blend $86 for 5 lb = $17.20 per lb (research notes); Dilworth 5 lb espresso blends $11.75 and $15.25 per lb.

ingredients.name: House blend for drip and cold brew, wholesale
ingredients.note: Planning value $14.00 per lb: between the two posted Dilworth 5 lb wholesale prices ($11.75 and $15.25 per lb) and below the $16.00 espresso blend. A batch-brew blend is usually the cheapest coffee on a roaster's list.

ingredients.name: Whole milk, gallon, delivered
ingredients.note: Toast, from restaurant and coffee shop invoices: a gallon of whole milk averaged $5.28 nationally in July (the page does not state the year); low-fat $4.34. The supermarket shelf price in October 2026 was $4.10 (BLS). A New York dairy route with a small drop is likely above the national figure.

ingredients.name: Oat milk, barista edition, 32 fl oz carton
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Oatly Barista Edition 12/case $39.99 ($0.10 per fl oz); lots of 85 cases $35.49. Shelf-stable until opened. 2.5 times the price of dairy per ounce.

ingredients.name: 12 oz paper hot cup
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Choice white poly paper cup $45.99 per 1,000. Same page family: kraft $48.99, compostable EcoChoice $82.49, Solo brand $72.49.

ingredients.name: Travel lid for 10-24 oz hot cups
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: $30.49 per 1,000.

ingredients.name: 16 oz clear PET cold cup
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: $59.49 per 1,000 ($53.49 from four cases). Other captures of the same page show $54.99 and $57.99.

ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Choice strawless sip lid $44.49 per 1,000 (another capture $35.49); flat lid with straw slot $31.99. The strawless lid costs 1.25 cents more than a flat lid but needs no straw, which New York lets you hand out only on request.

ingredients.name: Flavoring syrup, 750 mL bottle
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Monin vanilla $84.99 per case of 12 ($9.79 a single bottle); Torani vanilla bean $79.99 per case. 750 mL = 25.36 fl oz.

ingredients.name: Chocolate sauce, 64 fl oz
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Ghirardelli Black Label $118.49 per case of 6 ($23.49 a single jug).

ingredients.name: Chai concentrate 1:1, 32 fl oz carton
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Tazo chai 1:1 concentrate $35.49 per case of 6; Oregon Chai $36.99; David Rio $37.49.

ingredients.name: Matcha, ceremonial barista grade, 1 lb bag
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Jade Leaf Ceremonial Barista Edition $839.00 per case of six 1 lb bags ($139.83 per lb; $162.49 a single bag). Culinary grade $456.49 per case ($76 per lb); ceremonial teahouse grade $1,069 per case ($178 per lb). Some listing captures are old; matcha was re-priced across the trade in 2025 and 2026.

ingredients.name: Tea bag, foodservice
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Tazo 96-count case $24.49 (25.5 cents a bag); Harney & Sons 50-count box $15.99 (32 cents); Bigelow Ceylon 1,000-count case $67.99 (7 cents).

ingredients.name: Butter croissant, baked, from a wholesale bakery
ingredients.note: A national trade guide gives $1.25-$2.00 wholesale against $3.50-$4.50 retail. New York retail is $4.00-$5.49 (research notes, 2026), so I scale the wholesale price to $2.10: about 44% of a $4.75 shelf price, the usual half-of-retail rule. No New York wholesale bakery publishes its price sheet; ask for it.

ingredients.name: Butter croissant, frozen ready-to-bake
ingredients.note: WebstaurantStore: Bridor ready-to-bake croissant 2.8 oz, 80/case $109.99 ($1.37 each; $72.99 with the paid membership = $0.91). Raw dough that needs a proofer: Bridor 160/case $113.99 ($0.71 each). Almond-filled 80/case $96.99 ($1.21).

ingredients.name: Muffin, baked, from a wholesale bakery
ingredients.note: No published price found. Same half-of-retail rule as the croissant, a little lower because a muffin has cheaper ingredients: $1.75 against a $4.25 shelf price (41%).

ingredients.name: Cookie, baked, from a wholesale bakery
ingredients.note: No published price found. $1.25 against a $3.75 shelf price (33%): cookies keep two days, so bakeries price them lower and shops waste fewer.

ingredients.name: Hand-rolled bagel, wholesale
ingredients.note: New Yorker Bagels wholesale page (search summary): 12 dozen for $169 with shipping = $1.17 each; another page of the same seller shows $149-$239 by zone. A local route bakery is usually cheaper than shipped boxes.

ingredients.name: Cream cheese, bulk
ingredients.note: Foodomarket, New York wholesale quote updated June 1, 2026: $3.99 per lb in a 30 lb case (search summary). Costco business price for a 3 lb tub: about $7-$8.

ingredients.name: Egg, Grade A large
ingredients.note: BLS average shelf price, October 2026: $2.32 a dozen. It was $6.23 in March 2025.

packagingSets.note: Hot: cup 4.6 cents + lid 3.0 + sleeve 3.5 = 11.1 cents. Cold: cup 5.9 + strawless lid 4.4 = 10.4 cents. Compostable hot cup instead: 8.2 cents for the cup alone, a set of 14.8 cents.

menu.name: Drip coffee, 12 oz

recipe.item: House blend for drip and cold brew, wholesale
milk and sugar at the condiment bar

menu.note: 21 g of coffee for 12 oz (1:17), plus about 13% of every batch poured out when it goes stale = 24 g. Menu price: aggregator listings put a New York drip at about $3.00-$3.25; $3.50 is my 2026 planning price.

menu.name: Double espresso
menu.note: One 20 g dose. Recipe is trade practice: an 18 g double shot plus about 10% lost to morning dial-in, purging and remakes = 20 g; a pound gives about 22 doubles.

menu.name: Americano, 12 oz
menu.note: A double shot and hot water: the best gross margin on the bar. Recipe is trade practice: an 18 g double shot plus about 10% lost to morning dial-in, purging and remakes = 20 g; a pound gives about 22 doubles.

menu.name: Cappuccino, 8 oz
menu.note: A double shot and 5.5 fl oz of milk (5 in the cup, half an ounce left in the pitcher). Seen: a Manhattan cappuccino averages $5.88 in a 2026 city price guide.

menu.name: Latte, 12 oz
menu.note: A double shot and 10 fl oz of milk (9 in the cup, 1 lost in the pitcher). Menu price: a basic New York latte runs $6.00-$7.50 in a 2026 city guide; the research notes saw $4.25-$6.99. Recipe is trade practice: an 18 g double shot plus about 10% lost to morning dial-in, purging and remakes = 20 g; a pound gives about 22 doubles.

menu.name: Oat milk latte, 12 oz, $1 upcharge

recipe.item: Oat milk, barista edition, 32 fl oz carton

menu.note: Same recipe with oat milk: the milk alone costs $1.04 instead of $0.41, a gap of 63 cents. With the $1 upcharge the drink earns more than a dairy latte; without it the same drink costs 31% of a $6 price. Starbucks dropped its 70-80 cent upcharge on November 7, 2024.

menu.name: Vanilla latte, 12 oz
menu.note: Three pumps of syrup (0.75 fl oz) cost 21 cents and sell for 75 cents.

menu.name: Mocha, 12 oz
menu.note: One fluid ounce of chocolate sauce. Cocoa set records in 2024; the sauce price follows it with a lag.

recipe.item: 16 oz cold cup and strawless lid

menu.note: Ice takes the place of 2 fl oz of milk, and the cold cup set costs about the same as the hot one: an iced latte costs less to make than a hot one and sells for 50 cents more. Recipe is trade practice: an 18 g double shot plus about 10% lost to morning dial-in, purging and remakes = 20 g; a pound gives about 22 doubles.

menu.name: Cold brew, 16 oz

recipe.item: House blend for drip and cold brew, wholesale
16 oz cold cup and strawless lid

menu.note: One pound of coffee steeped in a gallon of water gives about 100 fl oz of concentrate; cut 1:1 it fills twenty 16 oz cups over ice (10 fl oz of liquid each): 22.7 g of coffee a cup. Steeps 12-24 hours, so tomorrow's sales are decided today.

menu.name: Matcha latte, 12 oz

recipe.item: Matcha, ceremonial barista grade, 1 lb bag

menu.note: 3 g of barista-grade matcha at $139.83 per lb = 92 cents: more than the coffee in a latte. With culinary grade ($76 per lb) the powder costs 50 cents. Aggregators list a chain matcha latte in New York at about $5.50.

menu.name: Chai latte, 12 oz
menu.note: Half concentrate, half milk.

menu.name: Hot tea, 12 oz
menu.note: One bag and hot water: the cup set costs almost half as much as the tea.

menu.name: Hot chocolate, 12 oz

menu.name: Seasonal latte (pumpkin spice), 12 oz
menu.note: Seasonal sauce is priced like chocolate sauce plus a premium (35 cents an ounce is my estimate). The drink carries a $1.25 premium over a plain latte for 38 cents of extra ingredients. Chains list seasonal lattes at $5.50-$6.50 in New York.

menu.name: Bagel with cream cheese
menu.note: A plain, unsliced bagel to go is not taxed in New York; sliced, toasted or with cream cheese it is prepared food and taxed at 8.875%.

menu.name: Egg and cheese on a roll
menu.note: Eggs at the October 2026 shelf price ($2.32 a dozen); in March 2025 the same two eggs cost $1.04. Cheese, roll and butter are my estimates. Cooking eggs to order needs a griddle and usually a hood; many small cafes heat pre-cooked egg patties in a speed oven instead.

menu.name: Avocado toast
menu.note: All four lines are my estimates: no price was checked. Avocados ripen and brown in days: 15% of them never reach a plate. Plated, so no packaging.

menu.name: Bottled water, 16.9 oz
menu.note: Estimate, no price checked. Add the 5-cent New York deposit, which the shop collects and must refund on empties of brands it sells. Bottled water sold to go is not taxed; drunk in the shop it is.

menu.name: Bag of beans to take home, 12 oz

recipe.item: 12 oz retail bag from the roaster

menu.note: A 2026 industry index puts the median bag of specialty coffee at $18; roasters sell retail bags to shops at roughly 35% off the shelf price, hence $11.50 (my estimate). Not taxed: food for home use. Beans go stale: a bag older than four to six weeks from roast should come off the shelf.

menuMix.note: Shares are my planning mix for a New York counter cafe, annual average, not a statistic: 111 drinks and 35 food or retail items per 100 orders. Anchors: lattes are the most ordered drink in 44 of 50 states (Square and SCA); whole milk is in 44% of orders with milk, oat in 33%, almond in 10% (Square, 2024); cold coffee is 17% of cups in winter and 21% in summer for all US coffee drinkers (NCA, 2026), far higher among young city customers (Starbucks: 75% of US beverage sales are cold). The mix gives $7.75 per order, 9% under the pack's $8.50: to reach $8.50 with these prices about half of all orders must carry a food item, or a third of drinks must be sold a size up. Cost of goods comes to 26.0% before shrink and 28.0% with a 2% allowance for staff drinks, comps and remakes. The pack's 28% (26% ingredients + 2% cups) stands as an estimate.
